question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do you work a job over the Winter Holiday?
options: Nah. Winter Break is for chilling out.
Kinda. I do odd jobs for my parents.

question_options.question: Do you want your own butler?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: However, there is the small matter of my ailing mother. She depends on the checks I send her, and... Well, if I am no longer to be paid here, I must find another line of employ.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Et tu, Jeeves!
Tom turns and yells at passersby...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anybody else want to pick up a knife and stick it in my back?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...Thank you, sir. I knew you'd be most understanding. Happy holidays to you.
Jeeves places his limousine keys into Tom's hand and boards a nearby city bus. Tom glances down at the keys in his hand.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Jeeves, wait! What do you do with these things? I mean, I know you use them to turn the limo on, but are you supposed to, like, talk into them or what...?
Tom places the key chain near his mouth.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'Engine on'... 'Limousine activate'... 'Automobile, roll out'...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I appreciate your optimism, Master Tom, and if it were just myself, I would gladly stand beside you through thick and thin.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks, Jeeves.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'm afraid so, sir. I'm told slavery went out of fashion in civilized societies several centuries ago.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, I know that... I guess I just always thought you liked hanging out with me.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Oh, I very much do, sir. I find your incessant whining to be most ingratiating.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But what about all that stock I bought two years ago?

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: You mean those shares you acquired in the company that makes the Buckin' Bronco skateboard?

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: That product was a disaster! It's now worth a hundredth of what you paid for it.

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Tom, I'm really sorry to be the one to tell you this, but there's no way around it... `You need to get a job.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tom, I'm really sorry to be the one to tell you this, but there's no way around it... [color=#e23b3b][i]You need to get a job.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: A high-pitched, lady-like scream shatters all the windows in the financial services building...
Moments later, Tom trudges forlornly out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Take me home, Jeeves.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Apologies, sir. I could not help but overhear the conversation you just had with your financial planner...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And it pains me to even mention this, but I have not been paid my salary in over three months and...

options.label: Wait a second... I pay you?

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: My fault?! `MY` fault?! Why, you spoiled, little...
nodes.text_bbcode: My fault?! [color=#e23b3b][i]MY[/i][/color] fault?! Why, you spoiled, little...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: I've been trying to get you to come in to speak to me for months now!

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: But instead of dealing with your problems, you've been out gallivanting around town, spending cash you don't have on things you don't need!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So not true! Who doesn't need a bear that crows like a rooster?

nodes.speaker: Mama Bear
nodes.text: `COCK-A-DOODLE DOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]COCK-A-DOODLE DOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aww, I need you, Rooster Bear.

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Tom, stop dozing off, and please just pay attention to me... The bottom line is this: with your father away or in hiding, you're now `poor.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tom, stop dozing off, and please just pay attention to me... The bottom line is this: with your father away or in hiding, you're now [color=#e23b3b][i]poor.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tom clutches his chest and gasps.

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Well, the important thing to know is that it's not `your` fault, Tom.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, the important thing to know is that it's not [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] fault, Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That's a relief, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: You see, after your father launched an unsuccessful bid to take over the town of Centerscore, his books were audited and certain improprieties were discovered.

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Until the investigation concludes, all you've got left is your rainy day fund...
The Financial Planner overturns a box onto his desk. A raincoat, an umbrella, and a pair of galoshes splash out.

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: ...And I'm not sure you understood how it was supposed to work.
Silas puts a hand on his son's shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, you need to understand that I won't be here forever. Some day, each of us will meet our doom.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I need to know that you'll be able to take care of yourself.
Silas hands Tom the check and then glances at his watch.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Oops! Sorry to cut the holiday short, but I'm late for an Aspen ski date with two lingerie models.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: See you next year. Tommy-boy, I love you!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I love you, too, Dad.
Tom and Silas awkwardly shake hands, and then Silas hops aboard his helicopter and flies away.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Bye.
Jeeves pulls out a laptop and opens it to a stock trading website.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Where would you like to invest the money your father gave you? I assume you'll be seeking a well-diversified portfolio of blue-chips and other...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Move over, Jeevesy. Too slow!
Tom knocks Jeeves off the chair and inputs a few quick keyboard commands.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There! Now we can start planning `my` holiday vacation!
nodes.text_bbcode: There! Now we can start planning [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color] holiday vacation!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Sir, if I might say... That did seem awfully quick for a complicated stock transaction.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Eh, whatever. I just dumped all the money into the company that makes this really cool Buckin' Bronco skateboard I just got.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's like riding a bull while standing on your feet. See?
Tom whips out a wider-than-usual skateboard. As he hops onto it, the skateboard begins to buck precariously!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! See that? Awesome, huh? And the stock was only, like, a dollar per share!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Sir, that contraption appears to be uncommonly dangerous. You might consider debarking it at the earliest possible...
The Bucking Bronco skateboard lurches forward, pitching Tom face-first into a nearby bookshelf.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ugh... Oh, my head... It...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom, are you all right? ...Tom?
And back to the present day...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...Tom? ...Tom? You really should wake up, sir.
Tom stirs...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Grr... What...?! Is the leopard on fire again?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: No, sir. I'm afraid it never recovered from the time you left the oven on...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: But it `is` after eleven, and your appointment with your financial planner was over an hour ago.
nodes.text_bbcode: But it [color=#e23b3b][i]is[/i][/color] after eleven, and your appointment with your financial planner was over an hour ago.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Seriously, that's what this is about? Can't we reschedule?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: We've rescheduled three times already, and your financial planner has become extremely insistent. He's threatening to freeze your checking account if you don't see him today.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Fine. Just let me get dressed.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Very good, sir. I'll start the car.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, and Jeeves, don't think for a second that I won't be rudely waking you up at two in the afternoon someday.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Dare to dream, sir. Dare to dream.
Several hours later, at the offices of Tom's financial planner...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: `I'M WHAT?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'M WHAT?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Well, Tom, the technical term is 'broke', but the Steinbeck crowd sometimes refers to it as 'going hobo'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: A joke? Of course you'd think that, Tom. You only ever think of things in terms of fun and games...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: But life isn't about fun. It's about responsibilities.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: No mistake. You see, Tom, when I was your age, our family had nothing.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I worked night and day, struggling for every single penny we now have.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I want to give you a taste of that experience.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Oh, okay. Thanks, Dad!
We hope you enjoy this episode of `Surviving High School...`
nodes.text_bbcode: We hope you enjoy this episode of [b]Surviving High School...[/b]

nodes.text: And make sure to stick around at the end for an exclusive special sneak preview of Centerscore Studio's newest game, `Cause of Death!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And make sure to stick around at the end for an exclusive special sneak preview of Centerscore Studio's newest game, [b]Cause of Death![/b]

nodes.title: A Very Tom Prince Holiday Special
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Tom survive the Winter Holiday?

nodes.text: Happy holidays, and welcome to another snow-white winter in Centerscore!
As you well know, Tom Prince learned a lesson last holiday season, but he's still got a ways to go!
Our story begins on this very day, two long years ago...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Well, Tom, it's the holidays again, and I'm told by your man-servant, Jeeves, that you've been 'acceptable' this year.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: My exact words, sir.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whatever. Quit fawning all over me and tell me what awesome presents I get.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Is it the jewel-encrusted Flambaro motor-scooter? A cosmonaut dipped in bronzium? My own tiny island filled with half-man, half-animal hybrids?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: No, Tom, nothing like that. You're your own man now. If you want an island filled with half-man, half-animal hybrids you'll have to make one yourself.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: What I'm giving you is an opportunity to do something for `yourself` for a change.
nodes.text_bbcode: What I'm giving you is an opportunity to do something for [color=#e23b3b][i]yourself[/i][/color] for a change.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...That doesn't sound like a present.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Well, it is. This year, I am giving you a check for a hundred thousand dollars. My `hope` is that you invest it wisely and start earning money on your own this year.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, it is. This year, I am giving you a check for a hundred thousand dollars. My [color=#e23b3b][i]hope[/i][/color] is that you invest it wisely and start earning money on your own this year.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: On my own? Is this a...
Tom races through the party, dishing out desserts at lightning speed!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: My my, these cookies are a delight!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: And such impeccable service!
As Kim walks by, her heel catches on the corner of the rug!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ahh!
In a flash, Tom swoops in and catches her!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa... Are you all right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess I'm not used to wearing these stupid high heels.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Too bad. You look cute when you're not dressed like a paper boy.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: ...Tom, was that a compliment?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No? Why would I... No!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Go ahead and wear your dumb, old tennis shoes for all I care.
Tom and Kim hang in silence for an awkward moment.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: ...Tom, really I just wanted to say thanks... For everything, I mean. You've received tons of compliments tonight.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I `have` been to tons of ritzy winter holiday parties. I know how people like to be treated.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I [color=#e23b3b][i]have[/i][/color] been to tons of ritzy winter holiday parties. I know how people like to be treated.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Anyway, that's everything for tonight. Meet me back at the bakery tomorrow morning, and we'll regroup.
Tom spins around, trying to serve the various party-goers... And grows dizzy!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa... WHOA... WHOA!!!
Tom steps on a teacher's foot and trips! He topples over backwards. His desserts pelt the crowd!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Russell
nodes.text: Ahh! It's a blintz blitz!

nodes.speaker: Ms. Prez
nodes.text: No kidding! If I wanted to be pelted with food, I'd babysit my sister's two year-old!
Kim rushes through the crowd and helps Tom up.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks, Kim. I kind of got dizzy and...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Just save it. The best thing you can do right now is get out of here. Meet me at the bakery tomorrow morning.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Oh, okay.
Tom trudges dejectedly out of the party.
As Tom moves to the side, he accidentally bumps into Kim. Their hands touch.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, sorry... I didn't mean to...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, it was my fault. I got in your way and...
Tom and Kim look down. Their hands are still touching.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow, that, uh...
Tom places anise gumdrops in a line leading to the front of the house.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey! That's a stone walkway! Super cute!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You think that's cute? Check this out.
Tom places a row of red sprinkle-covered, frosted tiles on the roof of the house and then dusts them gently with powdered sugar.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Ooh! You even added reindeer prints! That's great detail work!
Tom places a stack of licorice gum drops in a heap behind the gingerbread high school...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, what is that supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a pile of coal. Given the sheer number of malingering teenagers in this town, anyone handing out presents will `need` easy access to that...
nodes.text_bbcode: It's a pile of coal. Given the sheer number of malingering teenagers in this town, anyone handing out presents will [color=#e23b3b][i]need[/i][/color] easy access to that...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, Tom, that isn't...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And over here is where I plan to plant a forest of licorice switches.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom! Stop! Gingerbread houses are supposed to be an idealized version of the holiday season, not an opportunity for you to work out your petty grudges.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?! But I...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Then I suppose you don't want to include reindeer sport hunting, either? My father always said reindeer were the 'pigeons of the woodland'.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Hey, since you own stock in the company, I bet you know how to ride it. Do you think you could show me a few tricks? Pretty, pretty please!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I guess showing you `one` trick wouldn't hurt.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I guess showing you [color=#e23b3b][i]one[/i][/color] trick wouldn't hurt.

nodes.text: Tom steps onto the skateboard.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: See, you just kind of put your left foot here, and then you put your right foot here, and then...
The board bucks and bounces!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Hey... Are you okay?
Tom Prince bounces spryly off the skateboard!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Actually, I'm better than okay. This bouncing skateboard somehow fixed my aching back!
Kim steps out the back door of the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, break time's over. We've got one more task to complete, and then we'll head over to the faculty party together.
Tom hands the boy the skateboard and follows after Kim.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sorry, kid. Got to run!

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Hm. My dad's always complaining about his back. Maybe `he'd` like to try this skateboard out...
nodes.text_bbcode: Hm. My dad's always complaining about his back. Maybe [color=#e23b3b][i]he'd[/i][/color] like to try this skateboard out...

nodes.text: Kim leads Tom over to an elaborate gingerbread school house.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: This will be the centerpiece for the party.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wow! That's impressive!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Thanks! As you can see, I've already applied the first coat of frosting, but we need to work together to put on the finishing touches.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Grab some sprinkles, gum drops, and candy canes, and we'll get started!
Kim immediately dives in, placing gum drops on window sills and candy cane-colored stripes on the miniature lampposts.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This looks pretty tough, but Kim is counting on me to help her out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I should use these gum drops to make a...
Tom steps forward and catches the small boy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uhff!

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Thanks! That could've hurt a lot.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No problem... Although to be completely honest, I didn't do it for you.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: You didn't?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I own stock in the company that makes that toy. If you'd gotten hurt, that could've driven the stock value even lower.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: ...Oh, well, thanks anyway.
Tom steps aside, letting the kid tumble into a thorn bush!

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Why... Why didn't you help me?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If you knew me, you wouldn't have to ask.
Tom steps over the child and examines the skateboard.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! No wonder you nearly killed me. This is the same worthless skateboarding technology I invested in two years ago.
Tom freezes, and the boy crashes right into him!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ow! Watch where you're going!

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Sorry... I didn't mean to hit you. I got this skateboard as a present, and it kind of has a mind all its own.
Tom examines the skateboard.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! No wonder you nearly killed me. This is the same worthless skateboarding technology I invested in two years ago.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not only does Kim not appreciate any of the fabulous work I've been doing for her, but now my back is killing me.
A short while later, Kim steps out from the kitchen to find Tom ringing up the last of the happy customers!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, Tom, it looks like you really know how to handle yourself around customers...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And the tip jar is practically overflowing!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Eh, customer service isn't so tough...
Tom hands an elderly woman her receipt.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Take care, Mrs. Esterhaus, and I'm sure your family will love that ginger cake.

nodes.speaker: Old Woman
nodes.text: Thanks, dear. You were such a big help!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Heh. Well, if I can pull you away from all your adoring fans, it's time for your fifteen minute break.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, okay. Sure!
Tom steps out the back door, and...
A short while later, Kim steps out from the kitchen to find Tom surrounded by a mob of angry customers.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what happened?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: How should I know?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: For some reason, the rotund woman got upset when I suggested she purchase the low-fat fruit cake, and the tall, lanky man in red-and-white stripes was offended when I described him as candy cane-esque.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So you're saying you systematically insulted all of my customers?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I wouldn't go that far. Customers buy things. All these cretins have done so far is yell and throw sugar cookies!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, just go... Just wait outside. I'll come get you after I've calmed these people down.
Tom slinks out the back door, and...
...He steps into the parking lot behind Kim's Bakery.
He stretches out his aching back.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Fair enough!
The Old Man pays $23.14 and moves quickly toward the door!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait! I accidentally undercharged you!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Heh. Sorry, kid! Better luck next time!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Thanks, son. Here you are. And keep the change!
The Old Man pays $30.00 and then exits the store with his merchandise.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Now how much do I owe you?
Tom calculates the order total.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, the cake is $24.99, and tax is 8 cents on the dollar, so your total is...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's a cake in the shape of an old, mossy log. It's part of a Germanic tradition that dates back hundreds of years!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Fascinating! I love it when a store's staff is knowledgeable about the merchandise!

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: It is?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure. See?
Tom opens up the man's order to reveal... A `cake` in the shape of an old log.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tom opens up the man's order to reveal... A [b]cake[/b] in the shape of an old log.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: That looks more like a cake than a pastry. Grr. I hate it when businesses employ people who don't know their own merchandise.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Okay, then. Now my wife said I was buying us a yule log.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Come to think of it, what is a yule log anyway?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, a yule log is a...

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Bellweather. Clancy Bellweather.
Tom grabs a package from the shelf and places it on the counter next to the register.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Pretty quick there. Glad to see you're on the ball.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Are you dense, son, or are you just special? Why would you need my address when `I'm` coming to you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you dense, son, or are you just special? Why would you need my address when [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] coming to you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, huh, I guess you're right...

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: My order should be under my `name...` Clancy. Clancy Bellweather.
nodes.text_bbcode: My order should be under my [color=#e23b3b][i]name...[/i][/color] Clancy. Clancy Bellweather.

nodes.text: Tom fumbles about and eventually locates the package on the shelf.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Now grab my order. It's the one right there.
Tom grabs the package from the shelf and places it next to the register.
The first customer in line scowls.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Well, now that you're off the phone, are you ready for me, son?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure, I, uh... Sure!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: This is for pick-up, right? What's your...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'm sorry. Is this a prank?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, what...?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom, I've seen you dip your grubby, little fingers into the tills of dozens of your father's business ventures over the years, so I know you know how to operate one.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I suspect what you've now been asked to do is very much the same, only this time, instead of taking money out, consider putting money in. Now, good day!
Jeeves hangs up the phone.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Now, madame, about that blouse. I do believe that a 'summer' such as yourself would look luxuriant in this navy hue.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Tee hee! Aren't you a charmer?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huh... I guess Jeeves is still mad about the time I took all the money from the candy shop and blamed him. He had to work off a whole lot of gum drops that summer.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Customers? Well, Tom, I dare say. Customers are like anyone else. You should treat them with dignity, respect...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, so those are words I've heard of.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...And failing that, sir. Always remember one thing: 'the customer is always right'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huh... That sounds like pretty good advice, Jeeves. How come you were never this helpful when you worked for me?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I endeavored to be, Master Tom... but as you know, the customer is always right.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait... So all those times you agreed with me...?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Indeed. You were behaving like a complete and utter buffoon. Now, if you'll excuse me, sir, I must return to my work.
Tom hangs up the phone.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Huh... I guess I never really understood how much Jeeves was humoring me... Not that there's anything I can do about it now.
Tom fills the sink with soapy water and begins to wash dishes...

nodes.prompt: Make your choice! Scrub pans and then dry them!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! I think I'm getting the hang of this now!
Tom swirls the pans through the soapy water, rinses them off, and then deposits them neatly in the strainer. A short while later...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There! All done!
Kim steps into the kitchen. Her apron is flecked with batter and frosting.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa, Tom... You cleaned all these dishes already?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, it turns out that cleaning a cupcake tin is really not all that different from polishing golf balls at the pro shop.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, you did a great job, Tom, and just in time, too...
Kim steps into the kitchen. The sink is filled with tepid water. The dishes are mostly undone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what happened? You were `supposed` to do all these dishes.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tom, what happened? You were [color=#3b78e2][i]supposed[/i][/color] to do all these dishes.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My fingers... So wrinkled... Like little, wrinkly figs...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That's called 'dishpan hands', Tom. It happens when you wash dishes. If you don't like it, wear gloves.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You mean those yellow, rubber cartoon hands?! I might as well put on a hair net and hang a sign on my neck that says 'Low Class'.
Kim points to her hair net.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Uh, sorry?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Nevermind. Just leave it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm trying to finish preparations for tonight's big catering job, but the store is swamped with people who want to pick up their holiday pre-orders.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Do you think you can handle working the cash register for a bit?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh. Bring it!
Kim leads Tom to the cash register. Customers mill about impatiently.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Hey, you two! I've been standing here for fifteen minutes. Is someone going to help me or not?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Just one moment, sir.

nodes.speaker: Old Man
nodes.text: Hm...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, sorry to throw you to the wolves, but I've really got to get back to baking. Will you be okay out here by yourself?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh, I... I mean, no sweat! I'm great with people! I used to fire them all the time.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, well... I'll be in the back baking gingerbread men for the Centerscore High faculty holiday party we'll be catering tonight. Good luck!
Kim steps into the kitchen. Tom immediately whips out his cell phone. He speed dials the first number.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Hello? Who is this?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeevesy, it's me again.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Sir, now is not a good time. I'm currently at my new place of employ, and I...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're at work? Me, too! I'm the cashier, and there's a giant line forming. That's why I need to know how to...

nodes.prompt: I need to know how to...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: I need to know how to...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Excuse me, sir? '`Fake work`'?
nodes.text_bbcode: Excuse me, sir? '[color=#e23b3b][i]Fake work[/i][/color]'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, you know. Like whenever Dad asked me to do something, I'd have you do it instead. How do I do that now?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You `don't.` As I no longer work for you, I will be unable to complete your tasks for you.
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#e23b3b][i]don't.[/i][/color] As I no longer work for you, I will be unable to complete your tasks for you.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: So, wait, you mean I have to actually... Gulp... Do it myself?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'm afraid so, sir, and I would also strongly suggest that you get started immediately.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Employers often grow angry when their employees do not complete tasks in a timely fashion.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Really?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Indeed. In fact, I recall you being rather fond of manipulating my fist into pummeling my own bicep...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: All the while, you'd ask me, 'Why are you hitting yourself? Why are you hitting yourself?'

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Well, sir, I was not hitting myself then, and I am not speaking with you now! Good day!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeeves...? Jeeves...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Grr. He hung up. Now I'm going to have to figure this all out by myself.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Have you considered using soap and warm water, sir? I find that often works well.
Tom scans the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Soap. Check. Water...?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You might try the lever above the sink.
Tom lifts the handle. Warm water pours out of the faucet.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks, Jeevesy. You're the best.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: And I'm glad to see you're making something of yourself, sir. Best of luck.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, there's not much I can do about you losing your fortune, but I `can` help you with that last part.
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there's not much I can do about you losing your fortune, but I [color=#3b78e2][i]can[/i][/color] help you with that last part.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm catering a really big party tonight, and I'm not sure I can get everything done by myself.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'd hoped that Phil would help me out, but... Anyway, what do you think?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait... Are you offering me a job?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure. Why not? Just do good work, and everything will be fine!
Tom eyes Kim sharply.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I'd have to look over the benefits package to make sure I'm not spending too much out of pocket on health care...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Pay is minimum wage, and the only benefit is day-old cupcakes. Take it or leave it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Deal. You drive a hard bargain, Kim... Who do I order to do what?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, about that...
Kim leads Tom to the sink and points to a towering stack of cookie trays, cake pans, and cupcake tins.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, Tom. The first thing I need you to do is wash these pots and pans. You `have` done dishes before, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, Tom. The first thing I need you to do is wash these pots and pans. You [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] done dishes before, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Pfft! Of course! Only a totally sheltered, incapable brat wouldn't know how to 'do the dishes'. Who do you think I am?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, in that case... Great! Maybe I misjudged you. Get started, and I'll check back in a bit to see how you're doing.
Tom waits until Kim exits the kitchen and then whips out his cell phone. He speed dials the first number.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Hello? Who is this?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeevesy, it's me. Listen, I need help.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: For the last time, Master Tom, the doctor said it will go away if you quit picking at it.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Now, if you don't mind, I should really get back to my `job interview.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Now, if you don't mind, I should really get back to my [color=#e23b3b][i]job interview.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hiring Manager
nodes.text: Excuse me, Mr. Jeeves, is everything all right?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Yes, I do apologize for the interruption. I assure you, this will only take a second.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeeves, it's not about that. I've gotten a job working at the bakery, and I need your advice.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: `The` bakery? Do you mean `Kim's` bakery? If I recall, you were rather fond of the proprietor.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The[/i][/color] bakery? Do you mean [color=#e23b3b][i]Kim's[/i][/color] bakery? If I recall, you were rather fond of the proprietor.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: What was your private pet name for her? Ah, yes, the 'tasty, little strudel who also happens to make strudels'.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: A bit long-winded, that... But who can account for the vagaries of love?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?! You think I `like` that tomboy? Ha! No, no, that's totally, like, um... Uh, dumb?
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! You think I [color=#e23b3b][i]like[/i][/color] that tomboy? Ha! No, no, that's totally, like, um... Uh, dumb?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, Kim is just this cute friend, who also happened to be the first person I thought of when I was in a jam.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that hardly means I... Anyway, this is all way beside the point... Jeeves, I just need to know how to...

nodes.prompt: I need to know how to...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really? I mean, I know that most of your father's assets were given to Lucretia or were frozen for litigation, but didn't you have any money saved?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...A little, but it's all gone now.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, I know admitting that must've been hard on you, but I'm happy you felt you could confide in me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks for listening.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There's something else, too. My financial planner says that I have to get... Gulp... `A job.`
nodes.text_bbcode: There's something else, too. My financial planner says that I have to get... Gulp... [color=#e23b3b][i]A job.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: ...Okay, but 'slightly less rich' is still `rich`, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: ...Okay, but 'slightly less rich' is still [color=#3b78e2][i]rich[/i][/color], right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes, I mean... Duh, I'm Tom Prince. Of course, I'm rich! Who would I be without lots and lots of money to waste on frivolous things?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm just bummed because I had a bad day at the stock market, and...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait a second... Aren't the stock markets closed for the winter holiday?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Maybe?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what aren't you telling me?
Tom slides off his stool and slumps down on the floor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm completely broke. My financial planner says that I have to get... Gulp... `A job.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm completely broke. My financial planner says that I have to get... Gulp... [color=#e23b3b][i]A job.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Several hours later, at Kim's bakery, the door opens and Kim enters. She talks on her cell phone...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: I know it's the winter holiday, Phil, and I know you have to spend time with your family, but I've got a really big catering job tonight, and I...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: No, I'm not trying to make you feel guilty. I'm just saying that I could've used the help...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry. I've got to go. Somebody parked a limousine in the shrubbery outside, and I...
Tom sits hunched over the bar. He is surrounded by a dozen empty milk bottles.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Hiccup!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, how'd you get in here? The bakery doesn't open for another two hours.
Tom eyes Kim woozily.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If... Hiccup... If you didn't want people breaking in, you shouldn't have installed substandard locks.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil, I'll have to call you back.
Kim hangs up her cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what's going on?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: They left me. All of them. And now I've got nothing. I'm...
Jared leaps onto the rear bumper of a moving truck and vanishes down the street!

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Why are you stopping? He's getting away!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: We're not going to catch him on foot. Best we can do now is put out an APB.
You tackle Jared, smashing him into the curb!
Detective Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Gotcha!

nodes.speaker: Jared
nodes.text: Aaaaagh! Get off me, pig!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You better have the world's best alibi lined up for last night... Or you are in a world of trouble!

nodes.speaker: Jared
nodes.text: I'm not saying anything until I talk to my lawyer!
A few minutes later, you and Natara stand on the sidewalk. Uniformed officers have taken Jared down to the station.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: That was a pretty close call with that bus.

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: Yeah, I... It was...

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: You doing all right, Special Agent?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams
nodes.text: I... I am. Thank you, Detective.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: No, I just don't get it. We're supposed to spend the winter break together, but you're always either working or telling stories about Tom Prince.

nodes.text_bbcode: I'm starting to think that maybe you like [color=#e23b3b][i]him[/i][/color] more than me.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Whatever...
Phil rises and gathers his coat.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Look, I've got practice early tomorrow, so I think I'm going to head home.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: ...Oh, okay. We'll talk more tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: ...Fine.
Phil gives Kim a quick kiss on the cheek and then steps outside.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What happened? I have no idea how I messed things up with Phil.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And why would he think that there's anything between me and Tom? It's not like Tom likes me or anything.
The doorbell rings.
Kim throws open the door.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil, I'm glad you came back... Phil?
Kim looks around, but does not see anybody. A small present sits on her front stoop.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The tag says, 'Now that you're working at the bakery all by yourself again, I thought you might enjoy some company. -Tom'.
Kim opens the box and finds an adorable little kitten inside!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Sprinkles
nodes.text: Mrr?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Aw, it's `so` cute! Thanks, Tom Prince, wherever you are.
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cute! Thanks, Tom Prince, wherever you are.

nodes.text: Uh oh. It looks like Kim and Phil might be having a little trouble. And that present from Tom was actually pretty thoughtful, wasn't it?

Jared sprints around the stoves and streaks out the back door!

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: Stay on him!

You throw up your hands to block your face! The pot smashes painfully into your forearm!

nodes.text: Oh please. Spare me the 'tough cop' routine, will you? I've worked with enough detectives to know it's all an act.

nodes.speaker: Mal Fallon
nodes.text: And you think you know me that well? Have you profiled me?

nodes.speaker: Natara Williams

nodes.text: The next day, Tom Prince returns to the bakery...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Happy holidays, Kim! I'm here bright and early and ready to start my second day!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, it's three in the afternoon. The bakery opened nine hours ago.

nodes.speaker: Kid
nodes.text: Did it? I mean, I... Um...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Tom, I hate to do this to you because I know you're in a bad place right now, but I need help I can depend on...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, I'm going to have to let you go.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Great! I wasn't really feeling like working today. I'll swing by tomorrow, if I feel like it, and...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, Tom, 'let you go' doesn't mean 'come back later'. It means you're `fired.`
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Tom, 'let you go' doesn't mean 'come back later'. It means you're [color=#3b78e2][i]fired.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm the one who's supposed to say that.
Kim escorts Tom out of the bakery and into the parking lot.
As Tom starts home, he sees a sleek, black limousine pull up alongside him...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa... That's the Fjord X3200 Pangaea with extended cab modification. I've always wanted one of those.
The rear window rolls down to reveal... `Jeeves!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The rear window rolls down to reveal... [b]Jeeves![/b]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom. And how are we this fine morning?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not great, actually...  I just got fired from my job.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But enough about me, what are you doing in the back of that awesome limousine? I mean, isn't the owner going to be mad when he finds you there?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Oh, my dear boy, I `am` the owner of this limousine.
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh, my dear boy, I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] the owner of this limousine.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You?! But how?! Last I heard, you were working at a department store.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: I'll admit, my sudden wealth did come as something of a surprise. Do you recall all the money I sent to my ailing mother?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: It seems she invested it in a well-diversified portfolio. The market went up and now... Well, we're both filthy, stinking rich!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: The good news is, I am now in a position to help you with your job problem.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You see, I am rich now, and as a consequence, I am in need of a manservant.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You... You want me to be your `butler?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: You... You want me to be your [color=#e23b3b][i]butler?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Why not? It's honest work, and I promise to keep the floggings to a necessary minimum. Well, what's your answer? Are you in?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I... Gulp... I guess, I'm in.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Excellent! For your first task, I'd like you to push this limousine home for me.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: My new company is 'going green', and I'd like to set a positive example by conserving fuel.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You... You want me to push this big car all by myself?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Don't look so glum, my dear boy. I'll have the driver put it in neutral. And besides, it's hardly a more difficult task than that time you had me toilet train fifteen rutting gila monsters.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Yeah, I guess you're right.
Tom takes position behind the limousine and begins to push.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ufhh! Ufhh! Ungg!
Ever-so-slowly, the wheels begin to turn.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: UFHHH! `NGGGG!`
nodes.text_bbcode: UFHHH! [color=#e23b3b][i]NGGGG![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Wait a second?! What's happened?! Tom Prince is a `put-upon butler?` His butler is an `elitist jerk?!` Doesn't that seem backward to you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait a second?! What's happened?! Tom Prince is a [b]put-upon butler?[/b] His butler is an [b]elitist jerk?![/b] Doesn't that seem backward to you?

nodes.text: Coal, switches, even a spanking! Any of those would've been perfectly appropriate punishments for Tom, but this... This has gone much too far!
You have no choice. You must go back and play again! And this time, be sure to make better decisions!

args.text: Surviving High School
Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.text: The next day, Tom Prince returns to the bakery...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Happy holidays, Kim! I'm here bright and early and ready to start my second day!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, I'll be honest, you didn't get everything right yesterday, but the truth is...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It took me a while to pick everything up, too.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Just know that you'll have a job working at my bakery for as long as you want it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Great!
Kim hands Tom a check.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh. Not too shabby for a first day.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, that's not for your first day. That's an advance on your first `week.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Tom, that's not for your first day. That's an advance on your first [color=#3b78e2][i]week.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?! Impossible! No one can live on this kind of money!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What kind of game are you playing, Kim?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There is no game, Tom. I promise. This is just how much money normal people make.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But if this is all you make, how do you afford to summer in the Hamptons, winter in New Zealand, and tween on a balmy, equatorial isle?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, normal people don't do any of those things.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Oh. I guess I didn't realize that. Sorry.
That night, Tom exits the bakery and trudges home through the long, dark streets of Centerscore. Snow falls gently.
A short while later, Tom arrives at his small one-bedroom apartment...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hello...? Jeeves, are you here...?
There is no answer, only a bleak, oppressive silence.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh yeah, that's right. Jeeves `quit.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Oh yeah, that's right. Jeeves [color=#e23b3b][i]quit.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tom slumps down on the corner of his bed. He buries his face in his hands.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...Happy holidays, Tom Prince. Happy holidays...
Whoa... It's good that you landed Tom Prince a job at the bakery, but that just `can't` be the best possible ending! No one should have `that` kind of winter holiday!
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa... It's good that you landed Tom Prince a job at the bakery, but that just [b]can't[/b] be the best possible ending! No one should have [b]that[/b] kind of winter holiday!

nodes.text: Why not play again to see if you can get a better ending?

nodes.text: The next day, Tom Prince returns to the bakery...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Happy holidays, Kim! I'm here bright and early and ready to start my second day!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, Tom! I have to admit, I was a little apprehensive when I first offered you the job...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But you proved me completely wrong! You're one of the best employees this bakery has ever had.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, in that case, I'll admit that working here hasn't been the mind-numbing, sisyphean ordeal I originally thought it would be.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In fact, parts of it were actually quite n-n-ni... N-n-ni...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Are you trying to say the word 'nice'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa, whoa... Let's not go overboard here. I was trying to say 'n-n-not awful'.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh, well... In that case, you'll be glad to hear that your financial planner called here looking for you...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think you'll want to hear what he has to say.
An hour later, Tom waits impatiently in the office of his financial planner. The door bursts open, and the financial planner charges in...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm late, Tom, but it's been a big day. A very, very big day.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...It has?

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Sure, it has! Remember the stock you bought in the toy company that manufactured that terrible skateboard? Well, somehow they got the idea to repurpose the technology into medical technology...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: And guess what? It's a miracle cure for back pain!

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: I've been crunching some numbers on the expected stock gains, and all I can say is... No more slaving away at that crummy, old bakery for you!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Watch it! Kim works really, really hard at that bakery and... And...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And I guess now she'll be working there all by herself again...

nodes.speaker: Financial Planner
nodes.text: Sorry, Tom. I didn't mean anything by what I said. I just meant to explain that you're rich again. That's a good thing, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah! I guess it is... I just...
Tom looks out the window and, he catches sight of the limousine parked outside. The driver's seat is empty.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I have to go.
Tom drives the limousine through Centerscore. As he drives, he attempts to reach Jeeves on speed dial.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...It's no use. Jeeves wasn't at the department store he was working at, and he still isn't answering his phone.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...I guess I might as well go home.
Tom slinks into his apartment and almost trips over a pile of festive holiday decorations.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What the...? Who put all these wreaths and bows and candy canes here?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: It was I, Master Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Jeeves, you came back!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Indeed, sir. The holidays are a time for family, and I've worked for the Princes for over twenty years...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: As far as I'm concerned, that `makes` you family, and I could not bear the thought of you spending the holidays alone.
nodes.text_bbcode: As far as I'm concerned, that [color=#e23b3b][i]makes[/i][/color] you family, and I could not bear the thought of you spending the holidays alone.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Aw, Jeevesy. You're the best!
Tom hugs Jeeves, who immediately stiffens.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: ...Ahem. Yes, well, there is one other thing.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: You see, when I went to visit my ailing mother, I discovered her back problems were being treated with a Buckin' Bronco Chiropractic Skateboard...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Am I correct in my suspicion that your fortunes may have changed for the better?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I'm not nearly as rich as I used to be, but... Yeah! I've got `some` money, and...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I'm not nearly as rich as I used to be, but... Yeah! I've got [color=#e23b3b][i]some[/i][/color] money, and...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Wait a second... Are you trying to ask for your old job back?

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Master Tom, it seems that in the twenty years since I began working for the Prince family, my job skills have grown hopelessly out-of-date.

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Not to mention the fact that you repeatedly ignored my request to provide professional references...

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: But yes... If you would have me, it would be my great honor to...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Cut it out, Jeevesy. You're hired already!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now go whip up some egg nog and slap a few of Kim's gingerbread men on the good china. I've got celebrating to do!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Yes, sir. Right away, sir.
Jeeves starts toward the kitchen.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, and Jeeves, one more thing... Happy holidays, old friend!

nodes.speaker: Jeeves
nodes.text: Yes, sir. A very happy holiday, indeed.
Hey, look at that! You helped Tom succeed at a new job, cater a party with Kim, win back some of his lost fortune, and you even brought a couple of old friends back together!
No coal or switches for you, because you played a `great` game...
